name: De Nieuwe Winkel
dinnerNote: Seasonal menu on Friday and Saturday (€215 Tuesday to Thursday)
dinnerNoteNl: Seizoensmenu op vrijdag en zaterdag (€ 215 dinsdag t/m donderdag)

menus.name: Seasonal menu (Groei, July to October)
menus.note: Friday and Saturday price; €215 Tuesday to Thursday. Alcohol-free botanical pairing also €105. The menu changes three times a year: Ontwaken (March to June), Groei (July to October), Overvloed (November to March)

bookingOpens: Online through the booking page on the restaurant's website. Tables for each new season are released at a time announced first in the restaurant's newsletter.

bookingWindow.note: Each season's tables (three menus a year) are released at a time announced in the restaurant's newsletter.

cancellation: No deposit, but an amount is held on your card. Cancelling more than three days ahead costs nothing; within three days the held amount is charged.
waitlist: If your date is full, join the waiting list. When a table comes free, everyone on that day's list is emailed at the same moment, and the first to respond gets it.
groups: Up to 6 people in the restaurant. Groups of 7 to 10 dine in the private dining room at a long oak table, with the menu agreed in advance (not wheelchair accessible).
